category_title: Students with typical speech who monopolize activities and struggle with turn-taking
minimal_context: John is participating in a group collaborative planning session to discuss story ideas and plot for a classroom story.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to discuss ideas for our classroom story. Let's take turns suggesting what happens in the plot.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, now it is your classmate's turn to suggest an idea.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The dog eats all the homework!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Your classmate just said she wants the story to be about a spaceship. What do you think about her idea?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No spaceships! The dog barks really loud! Woof!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are going to discuss ideas for our classroom story. Let's take turns suggesting what happens in the plot.

STUDENT: A giant dog comes in!

TUTOR: Okay, now it is your classmate's turn to suggest an idea.

STUDENT: The dog eats all the homework!

TUTOR: Your classmate just said she wants the story to be about a spaceship. What do you think about her idea?

STUDENT: No spaceships! The dog barks really loud! Woof!

task.content: Discussing story ideas, suggesting dialogue and ideas about the plot for a classroom story.

context.environment: Classroom setting during a collaborative story-making session.
context.materials: Printed photos, notes, props, costumes, smartboard, and iPad2.
context.social_setting: Group collaborative planning session with peers and teacher.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: During baseline assessment of social and story-telling abilities when expected to participate in group discussion.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: He is unable to wait until asked to respond by teacher; does not listen to peers; does not respond appropriately to what peers say.

behavior_patterns.condition: When peers are speaking or making suggestions during the collaborative session.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Does not listen to peers; does not respond appropriately to what peers say.

behavior_patterns.condition: When waiting for a turn to speak during teacher-led activities.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: He is unable to wait until asked to respond by teacher.
